characters.name: Lin
characters.traits: 26yo female, slim build, waist-length black hair, signature red ribbon at neck, olive-green stand-collar service dress

characters.name: Guard
characters.traits: 40yo male, heavy build, scar over right brow, dark navy uniform with brass buttons

scenes.name: Station Hall
scenes.traits: old railway station hall, arched steel roof, wet tile floor, single hanging lamp

props.name: Brass Compass
props.traits: antique brass pocket compass, 5cm diameter, worn patina, faint blue glow on needle

shots.description: Wide establishing shot of the empty station hall at night, rain streaking the arched windows, camera slow push in.
Lin walks into frame from the left, coat dripping, medium shot, camera static at eye level.
Close-up of Lin's hand pulling the brass compass from her coat pocket, shallow depth of field.
Over-the-shoulder shot of the guard stepping out of the shadow, hand resting on his belt.
Extreme close-up of the compass needle swinging toward the east corridor, blue glow pulsing.
Two-shot of Lin and the guard facing each other, power imbalance shown by low angle on the guard.
Lin turns and walks toward the east corridor, back to camera, guard watches in the background.
Final close-up on the guard's face as the lamp flickers, cut to black on the last frame.
